decisions.statement: A subagent is named on a request by the `x-claude-code-agent-id` header.
A request with no such header names no subagent.
A header holding only whitespace names no subagent.
A request naming no subagent is refused by nothing, whatever is held.
A request naming a subagent nobody holds is refused by nothing.
A refusal names the error type `invalid_request_error`.
A refusal has the anthropic error envelope.
A refusal names the subagent and the agents panel.
A refusal says every later turn of that subagent is refused too.
A response is sent as json.
A refused turn asks for that subagent's page to be taken away.
A turn nobody stopped asks for no page to be taken away.
A held set naming no take-down refuses the turn all the same.
A seat's own turns carry no such header, so a seat is never refused here.
A refused turn ends the subagent, and its seat reports the subagent as stopped.

definition: the 400 a stopped subagent's turn is answered
